description: A C# game engine in which a program opens a window, draws each frame with plain static calls named as raylib's functions are, and draws Dear ImGui in the same frame, over SDL3, Vulkan and Slang, with an ECS and source-generated behaviors underneath.
releaseNotes:
The probes' reads take the field's info as the uniform holds it with their count beside it, no copy made, which takes the voxel game's cherry grove at 1920 by 1080 at High from 20.6 ms of scene pass to 10.4 on the development machine's GPU with every frame the same.
A program's shader hands litLight the shadow it read itself, so a shadow stepped along a grid of its own reads the map once a pixel.
title: 3DEngine
